def handler(context):
    # Shaping only. Unlike v2's node of the same name there is no description to
    # resolve and no ledger verdict to read: this workflow's input is already
    # classified, already domain-gated and already deduped by the feed builder.
    def s(key):
        v = context.get_input(key)
        return "" if v is None else str(v).strip()

    # Fit: the scraper-side ICP fit filter, applied after classification.
    # Only an explicit DROP stops the search; a feed without the column
    # (Other Sources, BuySide gap) arrives blank and is unaffected.
    fit = s("Fit").upper()

    return {
        "company_name": s("Company Name"),
        "domain": s("Domain"),
        "side": s("Side"),
        "classification": s("Classification"),
        "event": s("Company Event Name"),
        "source": s("Exhibitor/Sponsor"),
        "countries_override": s("Countries Override"),
        "fit": fit,
        "fit_keep": fit != "DROP",
        "seniority_group": s("Seniority Group"),
    }

fit.description: Fit decision as received, upper-cased ('' when none)

fit_keep.description: False only when Fit is DROP

seniority_group.description: A / B, or blank for the full seniority list
